Context: (xiv) Simplification of referral system»

Such treatments / investigations shall be provided on cashless basis in respect of pensioners, ex-MPs, Freedom-fighters, Hon'ble Members of Parliament (Rajya Sabha) and Hon'ble Members of Parliament (Lok Sabha) and other categories of CGHS beneficiaries, who are presently eligible for credit facility and the empanelled hospitals and diagnostic centres shall not ask for any permission letter separately. OM, dated 18-7-2018.
